This is the first open-source large Transformer-based text-to-video generation model.

sources.title: CogVideoX-2b: Text-to-Video model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: CogVideoX-2b is a lightweight text-to-video diffusion model that generates 6-second videos at 720×480 resolution and 8 frames per second from English text prompts. Developed by zai-org, it serves as an entry-level alternative to larger video generation models, prioritizing compatibility and low computational cost for inference and fine-tuning.
